# Training that Expires

Training does not last forever. 

Scouting America training expires to keep safety standards current and ensure all adult volunteers have up-to-date knowledge on protecting youth.

Training that expires regularly includes:

Online Training

- [Safeguarding Youth Training](syt.qmd) - Yearly
- [Hazardous Weather](haz-weather.qmd) - 2 Years
- [Safety Afloat](safety-afloat.qmd) - 2 Years
- Safe Swim Defense - 2 Years

In-Person Only Training

- [Wilderness First Aid](wfa.qmd) - 2 Years
- Aquatics Supervision: Swimming and Water Rescue - X Years
- Aquatics Supervision: Paddle Craft Safety - X Years
